freshness: (() => { const qa = window.__marketQA; if (!qa) return { checked: 0, stale: 0, example: 'no QA hook' }; const vh = window.innerHeight, vw = window.innerWidth; const now = performance.now(); let checked = 0, stale = 0, example = null; for (const tr of document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-symbol]')) { const r = tr.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.bottom <= 0 || r.top >= vh) continue; const idx = parseInt(tr.getAttribute('data-symbol').slice(3), 10); for (const td of tr.querySelectorAll('td[data-field]')) { const c = td.getBoundingClientRect(); if (c.right <= 0 || c.left >= vw || c.bottom <= 0 || c.top >= vh) continue; const field = td.getAttribute('data-field'); const shown = td.textContent; const truth = qa.truth(idx, field); checked++; if (shown === truth.toFixed(2)) continue; const rec = qa.recent(idx, field); if (now - rec.changedAt < 500 && shown === rec.previous.toFixed(2)) continue; stale++; if (!example) example = { id: tr.getAttribute('data-symbol'), field, shown, truth: truth.toFixed(2) }; } } return { checked, stale, example }; })()

interactions.name: sort by last desc
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field="last"]'); if (!th || th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'descending') return false; const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-symbol] td[data-field="last"]')].map(td => parseFloat(td.textContent)); return vals.length > 1 && vals.every((v, i) => i === 0 || vals[i - 1] >= v); })()

interactions.name: sort by last asc
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field="last"]'); if (!th || th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'ascending') return false; const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-symbol] td[data-field="last"]')].map(td => parseFloat(td.textContent)); return vals.length > 1 && vals.every((v, i) => i === 0 || vals[i - 1] <= v); })()

interactions.name: sort by volume desc
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field="volume"]'); if (!th || th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'descending') return false; const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-symbol] td[data-field="volume"]')].map(td => parseFloat(td.textContent)); return vals.length > 1 && vals.every((v, i) => i === 0 || vals[i - 1] >= v); })()

interactions.name: filter to sym004
interactions.until: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-symbol]')]; const count = document.querySelector('.count'); return !!count && count.textContent === '10 instruments' && rows.length === 10 && rows.every(r => r.getAttribute('data-symbol').toLowerCase().includes('sym004')); })()

interactions.name: clear filter
interactions.until: (() => { const count = document.querySelector('.count'); return !!count && count.textContent === '5000 instruments' && document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-symbol]').length > 20; })()

rest.transient: (() => { const els = document.querySelectorAll('td.flash-up, td.flash-down'); return { count: els.length, example: els[0] ? els[0].closest('tr').getAttribute('data-symbol') + '/' + els[0].getAttribute('data-field') : null }; })()
